overview: A retro 8-bit maze game where Max the German Shepherd sniffs out lost items while dodging mail carriers and sprinklers.
features: Play a retro 8-bit maze game as Max the German Shepherd
Sniff out hidden lost items with a glowing trail
Dodge patrolling mail carriers and cycling sprinklers
Advance through levels with increasing difficulty
Pause and resume the game at any time
Play on phones and tablets with on-screen touch controls
Track your best score and items collected
